verdict_rationale: Forensic source code audit reveals that prompt limit (P_max = 60,000) and completion limit (C_max = 16,384) are observed historical quantities, NOT enforced software constraints. The 31,384-token theoretical overshoot bound (Omega_max = P_max + C_max - R_min = 60,000 + 16,384 - 45,000) is certified strictly as a CONDITIONAL_UPPER_BOUND under the explicit preconditions that prompt context does not exceed 60,000 tokens and single-turn completion does not exceed 16,384 tokens. If prompt context or reasoning bursts expand to model architectural limits, single-arm overshoot expands proportionally. However, non-compounding across tetrad benchmark arms is a PROVEN_HARD_GUARANTEE: any ceiling breach immediately raises SafetyViolationError, halting the execution loop and marking all downstream arms SKIPPED_SAFETY_FAILURE with zero additional token consumption.

prompt_limit_audit.findings: Zero code in runner.py, orchestrator.py, or Codex CLI enforces P_max = 60,000. Large file inspection in Task B can expand prompt tokens beyond 60,000 up to the provider's architectural context limit.

completion_limit_audit.findings: Zero CLI flags (--max-output-tokens) or turn-level completion gates exist. Extended reasoning models (o1/gpt-5.6-luna) can generate completion/reasoning bursts exceeding 16,384 tokens in a single turn.

preconditions: Prompt context per turn does not exceed P <= 60,000 tokens
Completion generation per turn does not exceed C <= 16,384 tokens
Pre-dispatch headroom reserve R_min >= 45,000 is enforced by StreamingTokenTracker and Orchestrator
SafetyViolationError terminates tetrad execution upon ceiling breach

non_compounding_guarantee.mechanism: orchestrator.py:run_tetrad raises SafetyViolationError on TOKEN_CEILING_BREACHED; tetrad halts unconditionally with ABORTED_SAFETY_FAILURE
non_compounding_guarantee.tetrad_total_overshoot: Strictly identical to single breached arm overshoot

process_cancellation_latency_distributio.phase_5_4_24_single_sample_assessment: The 298.56ms measurement reported in Phase 5.4.24 was an optimistic single-sample outlier. The empirical distribution establishes that cancellation latency reliably falls between 500ms and 800ms on Windows.

remote_provider_cancellation_semantics.remote_billing_continuation: Provider-side inference bills for all tokens generated up to or during in-flight turn; zero cloud billing refund guarantee

adversarial_test_authenticity_b01_b20.b02_b03_audit_finding: B02 and B03 evaluated StreamingTokenTracker state transitions using hand-crafted JSON strings without child processes or real provider streams. Real providers emit token usage exclusively at turn completion.
